next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. If not present, there are no more results.

info.description: The Query Dashboard API is responsible for serving dashboard metrics using sidecar & snowflake audit data.
info.title: Query Dashboard API

post.description:
This endpoint triggers a search to return DAM metrics based on the provided parameters.
The `search_uuid` that is returned expires after 30 days.

parameters.description: Integration type. Allowed values: 'snowflake', 'oltp', 'all'.
parameters.name: integration_type

parameters.description: Resolution of the data. Allowed values: 'hour', 'day', 'month', 'year'.
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.description: Queries that ended before this time will not be counted. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Required with to_date_time.
parameters.name: from_date_time

parameters.description: Queries that ended after this time will not be counted. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Required with from_date_time.
parameters.name: to_date_time

parameters.description: OLTP consuming usernames. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.
parameters.name: consuming_users

parameters.description: OLTP repository usernames. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.
parameters.name: repository_users

parameters.description: OLTP consuming user emails. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 1024 chars.
parameters.name: consuming_user_emails

parameters.description: OLTP repository types. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10.
parameters.name: repository_types

parameters.description: OLTP repository names. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.
parameters.name: repository_names

parameters.description: OLTP repository sources. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.
parameters.name: repository_sources

parameters.description: Statement types. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Allowed: SELECT, INSERT, DELETE, UPDATE. Max 10.
parameters.name: statement_types

parameters.description: IP addresses. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 45 chars.
parameters.name: ip_addresses

parameters.description: Snowflake usernames. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.
parameters.name: snowflake_usernames

parameters.description: Snowflake current roles. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.
parameters.name: snowflake_current_roles

parameters.description: Query texts. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 15000 chars.
parameters.name: query_texts

parameters.description: Snowflake query tag values. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 512 chars.
parameters.name: snowflake_query_tag_values

parameters.description: Snowflake query tag names. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 256 chars.
parameters.name: snowflake_query_tag_names

parameters.description: Filter to only include queries where a tag is present or absent. Allowed values: TAG_PRESENT, TAG_ABSENT.
parameters.name: tag_present

parameters.description: OLTP connection status. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Allowed: SUCCESS, FAILED, ALL.
parameters.name: connection_status

parameters.description: Group by. Allowed: repository_name, repository_username, repository_type, repository_source, consuming_user, consuming_user_email, statement_type, query_text, ip_address, snowflake_current_role, snowflake_query_tag_name, snowflake_query_tag_value, snowflake_username.
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.description: Count by. Allowed: accessed_rows, query_count, snowflake_username, consuming_user, snowflake_current_role, repository_user.
parameters.name: count_by

post.summary: Trigger query audit search for a count using various filters.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the results of a search using the `search_uuid` provided by the /audits endpoint. The results are paginated and can be retrieved using the `next_page_token` provided in the response.

parameters.description: `search_uuid`.
parameters.name: search_uuid

parameters.description: Limit the number of results returned. Default is 500.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.
parameters.name: next_page_token

202.description: Search not complete. Results are not ready.

get.summary: Get the results of a search using the `search_uuid`.
